pov.label: POV (first person, vertical)
pov.still: first-person POV shot, hands visible at the bottom of the frame, eye-level, 35mm lens, natural light, cinematic color grade, photorealistic, vertical 9:16
pov.motion: subtle handheld sway, slow forward drift, hands shift slightly, ambient room sound, keep the first-person point of view, no camera cuts
pov.negative: text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, distorted hands

app-demo.label: App demo (readable UI on a phone)
app-demo.still: over-the-shoulder shot of a hand holding a modern smartphone, screen fills the lower two thirds of the frame, clean app interface with large readable type, soft studio light, vertical 9:16
app-demo.motion: camera fixed, thumb taps the screen once, soft UI tap sound, subtle screen glow change, keep all text readable, no camera movement

cinematic.label: Cinematic b-roll
cinematic.still: cinematic still, anamorphic 40mm lens, shallow depth of field, volumetric light, rich film color grade, fine film grain, vertical 9:16
cinematic.motion: slow dolly-in, gentle ambient motion only, atmosphere drifts, soft ambient soundscape, no fast moves, no cuts
cinematic.negative: text, watermark, logo, cartoon, low detail

product.label: Product hero shot
product.still: studio product photography, the product centered on a seamless backdrop, soft key light with a gentle rim light, crisp focus, clean minimal composition
product.motion: camera fixed, slow 360-degree turntable rotation of the product, soft light sweep across the surface, quiet studio ambience
